import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int[] DX = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    static final int[] DY = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    
    static class Edge {
        int to, rev;
        long cap;
        Edge(int t, int r, long c) {
            to = t;
            rev = r;
            cap = c;
        }
    }
    
    static class MaxFlow {
        int N, S, T;
        List<List<Edge>> g;
        int[] level;
        int[] iter;
        Queue<Integer> q;
        
        MaxFlow(int n, int s, int t) {
            N = n;
            S = s;
            T = t;
            g = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            level = new int[n];
            iter = new int[n];
            q = new LinkedList<>();
        }
        
        void add_edge(int u, int v, long c) {
            g.get(u).add(new Edge(v, g.get(v).size(), c));
            g.get(v).add(new Edge(u, g.get(u).size() - 1, 0));
        }
        
        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            level[S] = 0;
            q.offer(S);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : g.get(u)) {
                    if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                        level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[T] != -1;
        }
        
        long dfs(int u, long f) {
            if (u == T) return f;
            for (int i = iter[u]; i < g.get(u).size(); i++) {
                iter[u] = i;
                Edge e = g.get(u).get(i);
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == level[u] + 1) {
                    long pushed = dfs(e.to, Math.min(f, e.cap));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.cap -= pushed;
                        g.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }
        
        long flow() {
            long res = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                Arrays.fill(iter, 0);
                long f;
                while ((f = dfs(S, 1L << 60)) > 0) {
                    res += f;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }
    
    static int N, T;
    static String[] gridA = new String[15];
    static String[] gridB = new String[15];
    static int[][] dist = new int[15][15];
    
    static boolean in_bounds(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && x < N && y >= 0 && y < N && gridA[x].charAt(y) != 'Y' && gridA[x].charAt(y) != 'Z';
    }
    
    static void multi_source_bfs(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 15; j++) {
                dist[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        Queue<int[]> qu = new LinkedList<>();
        qu.offer(new int[]{sx, sy});
        dist[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!qu.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = qu.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + DX[k], ny = y + DY[k];
                if (in_bounds(nx, ny) && dist[nx][ny] == -1) {
                    dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
                    qu.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j)
                if (dist[i][j] == -1) dist[i][j] = 1000000000;
    }
    
    static long[][][][][] memo_dp = new long[65][12][12][12][12];
    static boolean[][][][][] memo_set = new boolean[65][12][12][12][12];
    
    static boolean can_reach(int t, int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1) {
        if (dist[x0][y0] < t) return false;
        if (x0 == x1 && y0 == y1) return true;
        if (t >= T) return false;
        if (dist[x0][y0] <= t) return false;
        if (memo_set[t][x0][y0][x1][y1]) return memo_dp[t][x0][y0][x1][y1] == 1;
        memo_set[t][x0][y0][x1][y1] = true;
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
            int nx = x0 + DX[d], ny = y0 + DY[d];
            if (nx < 0 || nx >= N || ny < 0 || ny >= N) continue;
            if (gridA[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Y' || gridA[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Z') continue;
            if (can_reach(t + 1, nx, ny, x1, y1)) {
                memo_dp[t][x0][y0][x1][y1] = 1;
                return true;
            }
        }
        memo_dp[t][x0][y0][x1][y1] = 0;
        return false;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            gridA[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            gridB[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        
        for (int t = 0; t < 65; t++) {
            for (int x0 = 0; x0 < 12; x0++) {
                for (int y0 = 0; y0 < 12; y0++) {
                    for (int x1 = 0; x1 < 12; x1++) {
                        for (int y1 = 0; y1 < 12; y1++) {
                            memo_dp[t][x0][y0][x1][y1] = -1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        boolean found_z = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < N && !found_z; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N && !found_z; ++j) {
                if (gridA[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    multi_source_bfs(i, j);
                    found_z = true;
                }
            }
        }
        
        List<int[]> src = new ArrayList<>();
        List<int[]> dst = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j)
                if (gridA[i].charAt(j) != 'Z' && gridA[i].charAt(j) != 'Y' && gridA[i].charAt(j) != '0')
                    src.add(new int[]{i, j});
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j)
                if (gridB[i].charAt(j) != 'Z' && gridB[i].charAt(j) != 'Y' && gridB[i].charAt(j) != '0')
                    dst.add(new int[]{i, j});
        
        int V = src.size() + dst.size() + 2;
        MaxFlow mf = new MaxFlow(V, 0, V - 1);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < src.size(); ++i) {
            long c = gridA[src.get(i)[0]].charAt(src.get(i)[1]) - '0';
            mf.add_edge(0, i + 1, c);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < dst.size(); ++i) {
            long c = gridB[dst.get(i)[0]].charAt(dst.get(i)[1]) - '0';
            mf.add_edge(src.size() + 1 + i, V - 1, c);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < src.size(); ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < dst.size(); ++j)
                if (can_reach(0, src.get(i)[0], src.get(i)[1], dst.get(j)[0], dst.get(j)[1]))
                    mf.add_edge(i + 1, src.size() + 1 + j, 10000000L);
        
        System.out.println(mf.flow());
    }
}
